rules.condition: Payment terms must be Net 30 or greater.
rules.flag_if: Terms are Net 15, Due upon receipt, or less than Net 30.
rules.alternative_text: All undisputed invoices shall be paid within thirty (30) days of receipt.

rules.condition: Liability must be capped at fees paid in the last 12 months.
rules.flag_if: Unlimited liability or cap exceeding 12 months fees.
rules.alternative_text: In no event shall either party's aggregate liability exceed the total amounts paid under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.

rules.flag_if: Any jurisdiction other than Delaware or US Federal Law.
rules.alternative_text: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware.

rules.condition: No auto-renewal without at least 60 days written notice.
rules.flag_if: Auto-renews without notice, or notice period is less than 60 days.
rules.alternative_text: This Agreement will not automatically renew. Either party may request renewal by providing written notice at least sixty (60) days prior to the expiration of the current term.
